title: Session ids in the State, and /continue resuming a Stage by its id
description:
Per the map tickets 'Limited' (harness-0sx.8, Session ids) and 'Apps per Stage' (harness-0sx.14, /continue resumes by id only on an unchanged App).

Each Stage's session id (herdr agent get <name>: agent_session.value) is saved in .harness/state.json beside its pane, with the App it ran on. /continue resumes a Stage by its id whenever its pane is gone, whatever the cause (herdr restarted, a reboot, Ticket 14's long limit): a fresh pane, herdr agent start with the App row's resume argv (claude --resume <id>; codex resume <id>), then 'continue' as its prompt, and the Stage is watched as a live session (run_stage's live path). Only while the Stage's App is unchanged in config.json; a changed App, or no id (no herdr integration), starts the Stage fresh on the current App, as today. /retry is always a fresh session.

Live check, unverified in the research, the user's after this merges: herdr agent start --kind codex -- resume <id> starts codex resumed, and agent_session is reported for codex panes. Do not run it in this session (it would open panes in the user's herdr workspace); list it in the PR for the user.

The reasoning behind each decision is on the map's closed tickets: bd show harness-0sx.<n> --json --include-comments. Research notes and prototypes live on local branches: git show research/<name>:docs/research/<file>.md, git show prototype/<name>:<path>. Vocabulary: CONTEXT.md. Decisions: docs/adr/. Rust; crates limited to serde, serde_json, regex, chrono, crossterm, ratatui and ureq, anything else needs a ticket.
acceptance_criteria: Fake world: a Stage start saves the session id from a fake agent get; a stopped run whose pane is gone resumes by --resume <id> on claude and resume <id> on codex, sends 'continue', and accepts the result written later; an App changed in config.json starts fresh; no id starts fresh; /retry never resumes; a live pane is watched as today. The PR lists the live check for the user.
